title: C++: Memory Pool Allocator
description: Implement a fixed-size memory pool allocator for fast object allocation.

steps.title: Memory Pool
steps.description: Create a MemoryPool class that pre-allocates a block of memory and hands out chunks. Store a free list of available blocks. Implement allocate() and deallocate(). Test by allocating and freeing several int arrays.
hints: Pool stores a linked list of free blocks in a char array.
allocate returns a pointer and removes from free list.
deallocate adds back to free list.
Use placement new for object construction.

verification.failureMessage: Allocate, use, and free memory blocks
